result.Method of Attack: Module replacement attack by publishing packages containing common module names (e.g., httpx, requests) with malicious code that replaces legitimate modules in site-packages; execution of Base64-encoded Python code that downloads and runs a malicious executable (Built.exe renamed to explorer.exe) from discordapp.com in a new thread
result.Discoverer: 奇安信技术研究星图实验室 天问供应链威胁监测模块
result.Impacted Systems: Python development environments using PyPI packages
result.Attack Vector: Typosquatting and module replacement via PyPI package upload; Importing replaced malicious modules in Python projects
result.Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Base64-encoded Python code in __init__.py of replaced modules; Download URL: discordapp.com for Built.exe (renamed explorer.exe); Malicious packages uploaded by authors 'crzydevvvvvv' and 'BigBoyDevelopr'
